DRAFT · for the Chief of Staff · not sent · can go with Note 1 or right after it 
From: Jonathan Paul Zschoche, attorney-in-fact of Patricia Keesey Zschoche 
To: Atty. Bonifacio T. Barandon, Jr. 
Date: ____ October 2026 
Re: Civil Case No. 26-360, the neighbours on 4 and 11 November

Atty. Barandon,

Two small things before the neighbours testify, both yours to decide.

**1. Who goes first.** Mrs. King and Shirley De Leon are our two witnesses for 4 and 11 November. I need to tell each of them her exact date this week, since the September order makes the settings final. My own leaning is Shirley De Leon on 4 November: her affidavit stands on its own, with nothing outside the record. Mrs. King's cases with the Balane side are where our proof of notice before registration sits (my next note), and the extra week lets us have the certified copies in your hands before Atty. Ramos crosses her. Either order works for us.

**2. The notarial stamp on the January affidavits.** I was putting my file in order and noticed that the stamp under the jurats of the four judicial affidavits sworn on 23 January 2026 (mine, Mrs. King's, Francia's and Shirley's) reads "Admin Matter No. 2023-424 valid until 12/31/2025." I expect your 2026 commission was simply not yet on the stamp. Could you send me the 2026 commission number and dates so I can note it in the file? If for any reason a new commission had not yet issued on that date, I would rather fix it now than hear it from the other side: the three neighbours could re-sign the same affidavits, word for word, before Atty. Andrade or another notary, and all three be filed together as replacement affidavits under Section 10(c) of the Judicial Affidavit Rule, which allows that once, before the hearing, with a small fine; I will cover the fine. For 4 November that means by Friday 30 October. I can bring the three of them to Daet on any day you name that week.

Nothing is added to any affidavit. We are not filing a supplemental affidavit for a neighbour; I would rather keep the court's one allowance for a late affidavit for my mother.

**What I need from you by 23 October:** (1) which of the two, Mrs. King or Shirley De Leon, testifies on 4 November; (2) the 2026 notarial commission number, or, if none covered 23 January, a day in the last week of October for the re-signing.

With respect, 
Jonathan Paul Zschoche
